name: busted_HIV1_RT

inputs.hyphy: HYPHY 2.5.65(MP) for Darwin on x86_64 x86 AVX SIMD with FMA3 zlib (v1.2.12)

notes: `hyphaeon busted` JSON (cli.py cmd_busted): Self-Liang site p, ACAT over variable sites, Simes over all sites, omnibus_lrt = sum max(0, lrt-3.841), neural BustedMultiTaskHead outputs (selection_probability, predicted_gene_lrt, synonymous_rate_variation, omega proportions). Head outputs 1e-5; counts exact. NEURAL HEAD FIELDS NULLED: model.safetensors lacks these BustedMultiTaskHead parameters coral_logp.theta_steps, coral_lrt.theta_steps, coral_omega3.theta_steps, head_prop.bias, head_prop.weight, head_syn_var.0.bias, head_syn_var.0.weight, head_syn_var.2.bias, head_syn_var.2.weight, in_proj.bias, in_proj.weight so they are random on every run (strict=False, no seed); predicted_gene_lrt, selection_probability, synonymous_rate_variation, omega_3/proportion_* and positive_selection_detected (which depends on selection_probability) are therefore null here and must not be compared. omega_1/omega_2 are constants (0.10, 1.00). Timing fields nulled (wall times are in manifest.json e2e_wall_seconds); paths reduced to basenames.
